summary: Noether Paper 16 R121 R120-based German patch webdrop. It restores the source-visible subtitle/author block, source-style bracketed formula labels [1]-[7]/[2a], source italics, and a local FreeSerif compile guard. It is a source-confirmed patch/rebase aid, not full P16 certification.

source_ia_jp2 and source_ia_png_native leaves for Math. Ann. 81 printed pp.25-30

relationship_to_existing_pending: Supersession is not established. Existing pending P16 entries remain 20260613_noether_p16_source_audit_webdrop.json and 20260614_noether_p16_ra53_sourcecritical_candidate.json.
This R121 package is based on the published/local R120 branch and should be used as a clean rebase/cherry-pick input for later cumulative branches if the fixes are not already present.
RA53 remains prior packaged targeted repair evidence; R121 adds source-visible front-matter, bracket-label, and emphasis repairs but is still not full P16 certification.
limitations: German cumulative candidate only; no English/Spanish/Japanese/French/Chinese/Ukrainian/Russian/Interslavic propagation.
Best staged P16 source is IA JP2-derived native page images with missing/ambiguous DPI metadata; better than older RA78/GDZ comparator, but not strict 650+ PPI certification.
Not full Paper 16 source certification, not whole-corpus certification, and not a critical edition.
Needs reconciliation against the next emitted web cumulative and broader R120/R121 branch before promotion as the live German branch.
recommended_next_action: Upload as a clearly labelled Noether P16 R121 patch/rebase webdrop only if preserving this patch evidence is useful; otherwise feed it to the active web/cumulative branch and wait for a reconciled Noether release. Do not describe it as Paper 16 closure, multilingual propagation, or critical-edition material.
